headline: Street light LED upgrade, solar and fuel cells on town property, and Sustainable CT project categories.
summary: The agenda includes a street light LED upgrade and solar and fuel cells on town property under the "ACES UP" program. It also covers Sustainable CT project categories, commissioner term expirations, and items from the 2019 Plan of Conservation & Development.
items: Executive session, if recommended by the town attorney
Discuss EUCC agenda decision making framework
Solar and fuel cells on town property with "ACES UP"
Sustainable CT project categories, such as tree planting and EV chargers
2019 Plan of Conservation & Development framed agenda items
Summaries of other board and commission meetings
location: Hamden Government Center, Third Floor Conference Room, 2750 Dixwell Avenue, Hamden, CT 06518, and via Zoom

TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
ENERGY USE & CLIMATE CHANGE 
COMMISSION 
 
REGULAR MEETING AGENDA

Hamden Government 
Center

Hamden, CT  06518

Meeting Agenda: The Energy Use & Climate Change Commission, Town of Hamden, 
will hold a Regular Meeting on Monday, October 19, 2026 at 7:00 PM hybrid via Zoom 
and in the Third Floor Conference Room at the Hamden Government Center. 
 
Meeting access: https://hamden.zoom.us/j/85799450772 
Meeting ID: 857 9945 0772  | By Phone: +1 301.715.8592  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
 
2. ATTENDANCE 
 
3. ADDITIONS TO THE AGENDA 
 
4. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
 
  a. September 14th 
5. PUBLIC COMMENT 
 
6. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.  
7. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney) 
8. REPORTS 
 
9. OLD BUSINESS 
 
  a. Discuss EUCC agenda decision making framework:
i. What is the goal of this Agenda item? 
ii. What information do we need to understand to map out the path 
to the goal? 
iii. Do we need to ask for approval/adoption by another Hamden 
Gov Entity? 
iv. Is the goal to make a recommendation to a town office or 
department? 
v. At what stage does the item need an EUCC vote to continue? 
 
      
  b. Street Light LED Upgrade 
  c. Term expirations — Submit a Commissioner Application: https://hamden-boards-and-
commissions.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/35021

  d. Solar and Fuel Cells on Town Property with “ACES UP” 
  e. Sustainable CT Project Categories: 
 
 
 
 
      
 
 
i. Tree Planting Program 
ii. Cool roof installation on a municipal or BOE building 
iii. Complete streets infrastructure build-out 
iv. Purchase an electric vehicle or electric bus for municipal use 
v. EV Charger purchase and/or installation 
vi. Energy benchmarking or energy planning 
vii. Energy efficiency projects in municipal or BOE buildings 
viii. Renewable energy or battery storage system installation in 
municipal/BOE buildings or properties 
ix. Municipal or BOE energy audit and/or implementation of 
municipal or BOE building energy audit recommendations
x. Community energy campaign 
xi. Other (please describe the climate mitigation benefit of your 
project. Projects not included on our list will be approved on a 
case-by-case basis. 
 
      
  f. 2019 Plan of Conservation & Development (POCD) Framed Agenda Items 
10. NEW BUSINESS 
 
  a. Any New Commissioner Applications/Approvals? 
 
 
 
 
  b. Summaries of other Board and Commission meetings 
11. ADJOURNMENT 
 
  
NOTE: The public may address any item on the agenda of a regular or special meeting and any 
matter within the purview of a Board or Commission at a regular meeting either electronically or 
in person, unless otherwise set forth or constrained by Law of the provisions of this Charter.
